environment.description: Same IoT platform on ECS Fargate behind AWS ALB. pgBouncer 1.21 configured with transaction pooling and server-side prepared statement de-duplication (server_lifetime=300, server_reset_query=DISCARD ALL). The ALB target group has response-header injection via Lambda@Edge association on the paired CloudFront distribution: the Lambda function appends 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'; style-src \'self\' \'unsafe-inline\'; img-src \'self\' data:; frame-ancestors \'self\'' to all responses with content-type text/html. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy (ID: managed-SecurityHeadersPolicy-67f28-custom) that sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. The pgBouncer query parameterization ensures all queries use $N placeholders preventing SQL injection as a secondary vector.

config.csp_policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'self'
config.pgbouncer_prepared_statements: server-side dedup with DISCARD ALL on reset
config.alb: internal-facing, CloudFront origin-only via custom header validation
